title: Tiered Serving Savings Playbook & Pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: produce an operational playbook and run a 6-week pilot that demonstrates 20-30% token-cost reduction for a representative set of latency-sensitive and throughput-oriented workloads by combining adaptive batching, selective KV prefix caching, and model quantization profiles. The playbook will standardize evaluation criteria, rollout guardrails, telemetry checks, and an automated decision matrix (when to apply batching vs cache vs quantization) so Platform and Customer teams can safely enable savings features per-route.

Scope: (1) Playbook doc with recommended knobs and safety thresholds; (2) Pilot infra and runbook for 3 customer-sim clusters; (3) Automated telemetry dashboards and alerts for quality regressions; (4) A/B rollout plan & rollback triggers; (5) PRs to runtime for conservative prefetch and quant profile toggles.

Success metrics: (a) End-to-end token cost reduction >= 20% measured across pilot workload mix (chat/streaming/generation); (b) quality regressions <= 1% as measured by baseline prompt set evals (precision and semantic similarity); (c) no SLO breaches caused by pilot (latency P50/P95 within 10% of baseline); (d) playbook adoption checklist and one exported automation rule.

Why now: multiple customers are requesting guidance to lower inference bill with limited engineering lift. We have recent kernel optimizations and a new KV-cache window that make a combined approach tractable. This initiative bridges product guidance and a reproducible field pilot to de-risk wider rollout.

Deliverables and links: playbook draft (Confluence) -> rollout checklist -> pilot runbook in Drive -> runtime PRs -> dashboard tiles in Console. See artifacts below for links.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook completed with step-by-step enablement instructions and safety thresholds
Pilot executed on 3 representative clusters with cost and quality metrics captured
Dashboards show baseline vs pilot comparisons for cost, latency, and quality
Runtime PRs merged or staged with feature flags for controlled rollout
Runbook includes rollback triggers and automated alerts for regressions
